So to break this down item by item for Elena: Payment allocation — $18,400 as wages, $33,600 as general release consideration, totaling $52,000. Release scope — the general release must expressly carve out and exclude the earned-commission claim, because that $18,400 represents owed wages that we are paying, not releasing. This is not optional; it's driven by the wage characterization of that portion.
